content: The results are shown in Table TABREF27 . As expected, they show that the RND and AMB blanks are more difficult to resolve (at most 40% resolved as compared to 61% for PERS). Translations of the majority of those blanks tend to be guessed by the textual context alone (especially for verbs). Image information is more helpful for PERS: we observe an increase of 10% in resolved blanks for del+obj as compared to del. However, for PERS the textual context is still enough in the majority of the cases: models tend to associate men with sports or women with cooking and are usually right (see Figure FIGREF21 example (c)).
